name: HEIDENHAIN LS 477, ID 605365-86
description: 920 mm measuring travel; +/-3 um factory accuracy grade; 1 um evaluated step. Delivered execution and machine calibration still require acceptance.

catalog.sourceName: HEIDENHAIN exact execution and manufacturer mounting catalogue

specifications.label: Installation dimensions
specifications.value: 1058 mm axial length; source drawing printed pages 38-39.

specifications.label: Procurement scope
specifications.value: One supplied LS 477 housing and readhead kit; mounting spar/cable execution ordered separately.

specifications.label: Feedback interface
specifications.value: 5 V +/-5%, complementary TTL A,/A,B,/B,Z,/Z, 14-pin flange socket; 5x interpolation, 1 um after 4-fold evaluation.

specifications.label: Accuracy acceptance
specifications.value: +/-3 um specified execution; delivered certificate and laser-calibrated tool-position map required. This does not certify finished-part tolerance.

specifications.label: Model limitations
specifications.value: Published source envelopes and mounting centers. Spar/clamp section, slot contour, recessed screw-seat depth, head flange and electrical socket contours are nominal installation envelopes requiring delivered instructions. No factory internal CAD or unpublished threads are reconstructed.
